# Barcold Refrigeration Ltd

> Kenya's leading refrigeration, air conditioning, and HVAC services provider since 2019 — supply, installation, and 24/7 maintenance of cold rooms, compressors, AC systems, and commercial kitchen equipment.

Barcold Refrigeration Ltd is a Nairobi-based contractor serving commercial, industrial, and hospitality clients across Kenya and East Africa. Authorized partner for GMCC and HITACHI compressors. Over 500 projects completed.
